traits.note: Mabberley's Plant-book (4th ed., 2017), under Osmundaceae: stems erect, wrapped in old frond bases and coarse roots; fronds once or twice pinnate or pinnatifid, with stipules at the stalk's base; sporangia not in sori, on the underside of the fronds, or on fertile fronds or pinnae of their own, sometimes a panicle at the frond's tip. Part-fertile fronds (royal fern) and separate fertile fronds (cinnamon fern) are both common; Leptopteris's fronds are alike.

traits.indusium.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 107, family Osmundaceae: indusium none, sori absent; read as "none".
